abstract: The base plate (1) has releasable holders and at least one socket, and a vacuum chamber (5) coupled to a vacuum pump by an inlet (11) and surrounded by a compressible rubber seal (8). Outside the vacuum chamber region, the base plate has at least one drill socket (10), protrusions above the plate level. The socket does not reach the level of the uncompressed rubber seal edge. Thus, after attaining a certain underpressure in the vacuum chamber, the rubber seal compressed until the drill template sticks to the wall in a self-supporting manner, while the socket presses directly against the wall to be drilled. ADVANTAGE - Versatile design for precise fitting.
